skills.name: Motion graphs
skills.description: Reading position, velocity, and acceleration from position-time and velocity-time graphs.

skills.name: Kinematic equations
skills.description: Applying the constant-acceleration equations to solve for position, velocity, or time.

skills.name: Vector components
skills.description: Resolving a vector into perpendicular components using sine and cosine.

skills.name: Vector addition
skills.description: Combining vectors by adding components, including for displacement and velocity.

skills.name: Newton's laws
skills.description: Applying F = ma to a free-body diagram to find net force or acceleration, often combined with kinematics to solve for motion.

skills.name: Friction
skills.description: Incorporating static and kinetic friction forces into a force analysis, including resolving the normal force into components on an incline.

skills.name: Circular motion
skills.description: Applying centripetal force and acceleration to objects moving along a curved path.

skills.name: Work
skills.description: Computing the work done by a force, including cases where force and displacement are not parallel.

skills.name: Conservation of energy
skills.description: Tracking kinetic and potential energy through a system where mechanical energy is conserved.

skills.name: Conservation of momentum
skills.description: Applying conservation of momentum, a vector quantity, to a system of interacting objects.

skills.name: Collisions
skills.description: Distinguishing elastic from inelastic collisions by checking whether kinetic energy is conserved, then solving for post-collision velocities.

skills.name: Torque
skills.description: Computing torque about a pivot and applying rotational equilibrium.

skills.name: Angular momentum
skills.description: Applying conservation of angular momentum to a rotating system.

skills.name: Orbital motion
skills.description: Combining gravitation with circular motion, energy conservation, and Kepler's second law (conservation of angular momentum) to describe orbits.
